Rauke.et: 16th century, from dialectal Italian ruca, from Latin ērūca. In the 15th century also erucke (and variants), perhaps from another Romance source or directly from Latin. The herb was little used in German cuisine until the 1980s, when in the course of marketing…

t: Die von der Kuh verschmähte Rauke freute den Ochsen.
The arugula that the cow did not want delighted the ox.
